setup: A mixed number is multiplied by a fraction.

steps.say: The mixed number combines [[w]] whole units with the fraction [[a]]/[[b]].
Writing it as an improper fraction multiplies [[w]] by [[b]] and adds [[a]], all over [[b]].
The two fractions are then multiplied straight across, numerators together and denominators together.

answer: So the value asked for is [[answer]].
